_comment: Tier triage questions and thresholds for /triage. Questions are in English (Jev accuracy). State may contain Japanese. Thresholds are initial values: calibrate against real triage.json history (source: jev vs user overrides).

is_local_change.instructions: Can this change be completed by editing at most two files while following an existing pattern in the codebase, with acceptance criteria that are already explicit and testable?

criteria.true: A typo, label, copy, style, config value, or a single field added to an existing structure; the issue text and signals show a small, well-understood edit
criteria.false: New logic, several files, a new screen or flow, or anything whose scope is not obvious from the issue

touches_side_effects.instructions: Does the change write to a datastore collection or table, publish an event or message, enqueue a job, call an external service, or change a config key or feature flag that other code reads?

criteria.true: The issue or signals mention writes, triggers, subscribers, jobs, notifications, external APIs, or config keys; or side-effect identifiers were found
criteria.false: Read-only or purely presentational change with no write path and no identifiers found

requires_design_choice.instructions: Are there materially different implementation approaches for this issue whose choice would change the architecture, data model, or module boundaries?

criteria.true: Multiple candidate approaches with close recommendation scores, a new subsystem or integration, or a change in how data is stored or flows
criteria.false: One obvious approach following existing patterns; candidates differ only in minor details

ac_is_ambiguous.instructions: Are the acceptance criteria missing, or too vague to test without asking the issue author?

criteria.true: No acceptance criteria, or several unverified assumptions had to be recorded, or the expected behavior for main cases is not stated
criteria.false: Acceptance criteria are listed and each can be verified by a concrete check

has_ui_change.instructions: Does the change alter anything a user can see or interact with in the UI?

criteria.true: Screens, components, copy, layout, or interactions change
criteria.false: Backend, data, infrastructure, or tooling only

thresholds._comment: Evaluated top-down; first match wins. Values are Noul probabilities (0-1).

promote._comment: Rule-based (no Jev). Applied at stage=promote using plan.md. Only ever raises the tier by one level.

fallback._comment: When Jev is unavailable, the triage runner (Opus, effort medium) answers the same questions with a probability 0-1 each, in JSON, using only the same state. Same thresholds apply.
